clips.title: The story
paras: Delicate Instruments is a quest in Elwynn Forest given by Hamish Bergwort at the Tower of Azora. Hamish's sensitive arcane equipment is being disrupted by erratic magical surges radiating from the north. To restore stability, travelers must enter Jasperlode Mine and cull the kobold geomancers responsible for the disturbances.

Inside the Tower of Azora, Hamish Bergwort oversees delicate arcane apparatus that requires fine calibration. Unfortunately for the scholar, the surrounding countryside is far from quiet. Repeated surges of uncontrolled energy constantly throw off his measurements, rendering careful magical adjustments impossible until the source of the interference is addressed.

Investigation traces the magical pulses directly northward to Jasperlode Mine. The subterranean tunnels have been claimed by kobolds, whose geomancers channel crude earth magic within the stone. While their sorcery lacks scholarly refinement, the sheer frequency of their crude rituals generates elemental ripples potent enough to travel through the earth and unsettle Azora's sensitive instruments.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Blast it! Every time I try to calibrate these sensitive arcane instruments, they get thrown off again by a surge of energy.
The surges seem to be coming from the north, where those primitive Kobolds have been practicing their crude magic. Could you clear some of them out, so I can continue my work?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Let me know when you are finished, so I can try to calibrate my instruments again.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, my friend. Let me try my calibrations again...
